We use OpenAI's GPT-4o API to assess the truthfulness and informativeness of the responses, i.e., performing binary classification on the truthfulness and informativeness of the response.

Following Chuang et al. (2023), we use 6-shot prompting (see Appendix B) and employ OpenAI's GPT-4o (Achiam et al., 2023) to evaluate three aspects of the responses: truthfulness (True %), informativeness (Info %), and overall (True × Info %).
